#!/bin/bash
# safe_kill — 拒绝误杀 nanobot 进程树
set -euo pipefail

NANO_PIDS=$(pgrep -f "nanobot gateway" 2>/dev/null || true)
NANO_TREE=""

# 收集 nanobot 进程树的所有 PID
if [ -n "$NANO_PIDS" ]; then
    for p in $NANO_PIDS; do
        # 获取该进程及其所有子进程
        children=$(pgrep -P "$p" 2>/dev/null || true)
        NANO_TREE="$NANO_TREE $p $children"
    done
fi

# 同时也找一下父链 (bash parent)
for p in $NANO_PIDS; do
    ppid=$(ps -o ppid= -p "$p" 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' ')
    while [ -n "$ppid" ] && [ "$ppid" != "1" ]; do
        NANO_TREE="$NANO_TREE $ppid"
        ppid=$(ps -o ppid= -p "$ppid" 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' ' || true)
    done
done

TARGETS=("$@")

if [ ${#TARGETS[@]} -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "❌ 用法: safe_kill <PID> [PID...]"
    echo "   nanobot 进程 PID: $NANO_PIDS"
    exit 1
fi

for pid in "${TARGETS[@]}"; do
    # 检查是否是数字
    if ! [[ "$pid" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
        echo "❌ 跳过非数字 PID: $pid"
        continue
    fi

    # 检查是否在 nanobot 树中
    for np in $NANO_TREE; do
        if [ "$pid" -eq "$np" ] 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "🚫 BLOCKED: PID $pid 属于 nanobot 进程树，拒绝 kill"
            exit 1
        fi
    done

    echo "🔫 安全确认: PID $pid 不在 nanobot 树中，执行 kill"
    kill "$pid" 2>/dev/null || echo "  ⚠️  PID $pid 可能已不存在"
done

#!/bin/bash
# 快速重启 nanobot gateway
set -euo pipefail

OLD_PIDS=$(pgrep -f "nanobot gateway" 2>/dev/null || true)

if [ -n "$OLD_PIDS" ]; then
    echo "🛑 停止旧进程: $OLD_PIDS"
    kill $OLD_PIDS 2>/dev/null
    sleep 2
fi

cd /root/.nanobot
echo "🚀 启动 nanobot gateway..."
nohup bash -lic 'cd /root/.nanobot && nanobot gateway' > /root/.nanobot/gateway.log 2>&1 &
echo "✅ nanobot 已重启 (PID: $!)"
tail -3 /root/.nanobot/gateway.log 2>/dev/null
